evidence_mode: toy integrated closed-loop model; official architecture explanation
learning_objective: Explain localization, costmaps, planning, control and orchestration as a feedback system.

brief.question: What happens after setting a goal?
brief.mechanism: Sensor changes cause obstacle estimates, cost/path updates and changed velocity commands.
brief.hero_experiment: Same start/goal with and without an appearing moving obstacle.
brief.system_takeaway: Path is a spatial reference; controller outputs velocity; robot generates next observation.

frame: single world frame x forward/right on diagram, y up, yaw CCW; ideal co-located lidar

contracts.boundary: Lidar + known static map + ideal Pose -> obstacle estimate
contracts.data: circle-fit center; known 0.30m radius; no truth object labels

contracts.boundary: Path + obstacle distance field + state -> Controller
contracts.data: candidate constant-twist rollouts, horizon 1.5s, selected v/w
exact differential-drive kinematics, wheel radius .1m, track .45m

assumptions: Ideal localization input; AMCL not executed
Static map plus estimated circular obstacle; local distance checks replace full Nav2 rolling costmap
Instant ideal stop on invalid path; no slip, actuator dynamics, contact forces, TF, networking or latency
Single seed and one trial per condition; no general performance claims
Blender is trace playback; annotation holds and video mapping in timeline.json
collision_evaluation: Minimum circular footprint clearance sampled additionally at 100Hz in validate.py; not a continuous safety proof
